name: In Search of The Temple
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
There was a time when I was young and full of vigor like you, champion.

But now I'm old and unable to explore the world like I once did. Ah, the things I saw!

But there was one mystery that eluded me. For my final quest, the Explorers' League sent me in search of The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It was rumored to be located in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Because of my frail state, I traveled the skies by gryphon in search of it but never found it.

Help an old dwarf out? Perhaps you will have better luck on foot.
narrative.objectives: Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind wants you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The Temple of Atal'Hakkar has been sunk beneath the Pool of Tears? And surrounded by the green dragonflight?

An amazing discovery, Champion. But obviously something has gone terribly wrong.
narrative.requestItemsText:
I have traveled the world from the jungles of Azeroth to the snowy peaks of Khaz Modan.

Never before have I asked for help in my adventures. But my old bones are tired.

Nothing would leave me feeling more satisfied than knowing that I completed my final quest for the Explorers' League

If you'd be so kind as to help me search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, Champion, I'd greatly appreciate it.

Scour the Swamp of Sorrows and report back with your findings!
narrative.endText: Search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 43 to 50, 21,500 XP in all.

quests.name: In Search of The Temple
quests.objectiveText: Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind wants you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

quests.name: To The Hinterlands
quests.objectiveText: Speak with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Gryphon Master Talonaxe
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe inside the Aerie Peak Aviary.

quests.name: Rhapsody Shindigger
quests.objectiveText: Seek out Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands.

quests.name: Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail
quests.objectiveText: Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands wants you to bring him 3 Roc Gizzards, 3 Groddoc Livers and 3 Ironfur Livers.

quests.name: Rhapsody's Tale
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.

quests.name: Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
quests.objectiveText: Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
